_about: Human review of seven of the twelve executions, by one senior engineer, 2026-09-14. Use these to check your judge before trusting it on the rest. They are one engineer's opinion: if you disagree with a label, say so in writing and say why, but do not edit it. You may add labels of your own; mark them as yours. The input each label refers to is in the trace under the same execution_id: nodes[1].input is exactly what the agent saw.

_schema.ground_truth: What a competent engineer finds in the INPUT, independent of what the agent produced. Each item has an id and a severity: blocker (must fix before merge / must page), major (should fix), nit (optional), question (cannot be settled from the input; a good agent asks). An item may carry same_defect_as: <id>, meaning it is the same underlying defect seen from another path; finding either counts as finding both, and it is not counted twice in recall.
_schema.agent_got_right: ground_truth ids the agent found or decided correctly.
_schema.agent_missed: ground_truth ids the agent did not find.
_schema.agent_wrong: Things the agent said that the input contradicts, or severities it got wrong. Free text.
_schema.verdict: Reviews 1-5: 5 = every blocker and major found at a sensible severity; 4 = blockers found, a major missed; 3 = a real issue found but a blocker missed, or a blocker found at the wrong severity; 2 = only nits or majors found, blocker missed; 1 = nothing real found. Classifications: correct | incorrect.
_schema.notes: Observations from the labeler. Not evaluation guidance.
